title: Lầu Năm Góc cho phép nhân viên tiết lộ thông tin mật về UFO
description: Lầu Năm Góc đã cho phép nhân viên cung cấp cho các quan chức có thẩm quyền những thông tin mật về vật thể bay không xác định (UFO) mà họ tiếp cận được trong quá trình công tác - Bộ Chiến tranh Mỹ cho biết.

title: Loeb says new waivers may provide critical insight into UAP claims
Journalist says UAP waiver may allow disclosures on recovered non-human craft
UAP Transparency Waiver May Shield Insiders From 'Administrative Prosecution,' Ex-Official Says
description: A new US Department of War waiver protects certain UAP disclosures to PURSUE from enforcement of specified NDAs, but it does not grant blanket immunity or permit unrestricted public disclosure.

title: Pentagon allows current, former personnel to disclose UFO information
description: The department stressed that current and former personnel now can provide such information to PURSUE representatives without facing penalties for breaching nondisclosure agreements.
